ov: القطار القطبي السريع (الإنجليزية: The Polar Express) هو فيلم فنتازيا تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 2004. الفيلم من إخراج روبرت زيميكس.
plotEn:
On Christmas Eve in Grand Rapids, Michigan, the Polar Express, a magical train bound for the North Pole, stops outside the house of a boy named Christopher who is beginning to doubt the existence of Santa Claus. He boards the train after being invited by James the Conductor, befriending a spirited girl named Holly and a know-it-all boy named Lenny in the passenger car. The train stops to pick up a lonely boy named Billy, whom Christopher saves from missing its departure by pulling the emergency brake. Billy chooses to sit alone in the observation car.
The children are served hot chocolate, and Holly leaves with James to deliver Billy a cup. Christopher notices her unstamped ticket and attempts to return it to her. The ticket blows through the wilderness and eventually finds its way back onto the train. When Holly discovers that her ticket is missing, James escorts her out of the passenger car. Fearing that she will be disembarked, Christopher travels across the roof to find her, aided by a ghostly Hobo.
Upon reaching the engine, he finds Holly driving the train, as the engineer and fireman repair the headlamp. Following a near miss with a herd of caribou, a throttle malfunction causes the train to speed down a steep hill onto a frozen lake. The lost throttle pin nearly causes a disaster before the engineer regains control.
